repository.name: My CloudStream Repo
repository.description: Personal CloudStream extensions — self-hosted, automated builds

verification.notes: Home, listing, pagination, category filter, search and detail playback verified against live HTML. Search uses GET /movies?search= (the site's own /search_movies AJAX endpoint returns HTTP 500). Playback URL returns HTTP 206 video/x-matroska.

sites.description: CTG Movies — movies, TV shows and anime.

verification.listings: VERIFIED against first-party HTML captured from an authorised network. Card parsing measured on four captures: home 112 cards, /movies 32, /tv 32, /anime 32, all with title + poster (108/30/29/30 also carry a release year).
verification.detailUrl: CONFIRMED by the site owner: https://ctgmovies.com/movies/<slug> — the same href the listing cards already expose, so load() receives a real detail URL.
verification.details: UNVERIFIED — no detail-page capture was supplied, so the title/poster/plot selectors fall back to primitives already proven on the listings (h1, og:image, og:description).
verification.playback: UNVERIFIED and intentionally gated. The site requires a signed-in account to play; that authentication gate is NOT bypassed. loadLinks() reports only media the page exposes to an already-authorised client and returns false otherwise.
verification.environment: ctgmovies.com is not reachable from the build environment (port 443 TLS timeout); all verification above used owner-supplied captures.

sites.description: Khulna Plex — Bangla, Hindi, English and dubbed movies plus series.

verification.listings: VERIFIED against first-party HTML captured from an authorised network. Hero carousel parses to real watch URLs (119 cards on the home capture, 96 with a year); series grid parses 20 cards with title + poster.
verification.detailUrl: CONFIRMED by the site owner: http://khulnaplex.net/watch.php?id=<numeric>&type=<movie|series>. Hero cards already emit exactly this form.
verification.details: PARTIAL. watch.php is confirmed as the detail endpoint, but no watch-page capture was supplied, so title/poster/plot selectors are unverified.
verification.knownLimitation: Grid cards (div.movie-card) carry NO anchor/href in the rendered markup — the live site navigates through a JS handler whose content id lives in <script> blocks that MHTML saving strips. Grid cards therefore expose title/poster/year but no id. They resolve on open via the site's own search (see gridCardUrl/resolveTitle). No id is ever invented.
verification.playback: UNVERIFIED. loadLinks() reads the watch page's own <video>/<source>, download.php?file= media paths and non-cid: iframes via CloudStream's extractor registry. Nothing is bypassed.
verification.environment: khulnaplex.net is not reachable from the build environment (Cloudflare 403); all verification above used owner-supplied captures.
